blocks.text: Kirchhoff ke rules circuit analysis ke do basic principles (bunyadi usool) hain jo circuits mein current aur voltage maloom karne mein madad dete hain. Yeh khaas taur par un complex (uljha hua) circuits ke liye kaam aate hain jo sirf Ohm's law aur series ya parallel combination (jor) se solve (hal) nahi ho sakte.
Kirchhoff ka pehla rule
Yeh kehta hai ke circuit mein kisi point par milne wale saare currents ka sum (jor) zero hota hai:
Convention (riwayat) yeh hai ke point ki taraf aane wala current positive (musbat) aur point se door jane wala current negative (manfi) liya jata hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat ke liye (For Your Information)
blocks.text: Node circuit ka woh point hai jo do ya zyada branches (shaakhein) ko jorta hai.
Maan lein chaar taar ek point A par milte hain (Fig. 9.27). A ki taraf aane wale currents I₁ aur I₂ hain aur door jane wale I₃ aur I₄.

blocks.alt: Chaar taarein, har ek mein resistor, nuqte A par milti hain. Teer: I1 (baen se) aur I2 (neeche baen se) A ki taraf; I3 (neeche daen) aur I4 (oopar daen) A se door.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.27: Kirchhoff ke first rule ke mutabiq I1 + I2 = I3 + I4 (kitab ki Figure 9.27 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Fig. 9.27 ki caption mein I₁ + I₃ = I₂ + I₄ chhapti hai, jo us ke apne text aur Eq. 9.44 ke khilaf hai. A mein aane wale currents I₁ aur I₂ hain, is liye sahi relation I₁ + I₂ = I₃ + I₄ hai.
Convention ke mutabiq I₁ aur I₂ positive aur I₃ aur I₄ negative hain. Eq. 9.43 lagane se:
Eq. 9.44 se pehla rule doosre lafzon mein:

blocks.title: Kirchhoff ka pehla rule
blocks.text: Kisi point ki taraf aane wale saare currents ka sum us point se door jane wale saare currents ke sum ke barabar hota hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jaante hain? (Do You Know?)
blocks.text: Jis node ka potential zero maana jaye use datum node kehte hain.

Kirchhoff ka pehla rule (jise point rule bhi kehte hain) law of conservation of charge (charge na banta hai na mit-ta hai) ki shakal hai. Agar kisi point par charge jama ya paida na ho raha ho to jitna charge point ki taraf aata hai utna hi us se door jata hai.
Kirchhoff ka doosra rule

Yeh kehta hai ke kisi band circuit (loop) mein voltage ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic sum zero hona chahiye. Fig. 9.28 ka band circuit lein. Current I ki direction (rukh) us cell par depend karti hai jis ka emf zyada ho. Maan lein E₁ bara hai, is liye current anticlockwise (ghari ki ulti direction) behta hai. Steady current positive charges ka lagatar flow (bahao) samjha ja sakta hai. Voltage ki tabdeeli woh kaam (ya energy) hai jo unit positive charge ek point se doosre tak jate hue hasil karta ya khota hai.

Jab positive charge Q cell E₁ mein kam (−) se zyada (+) potential ki taraf guzarta hai to us par kaam hota hai aur woh energy E₁Q hasil karta hai (Eq. 9.41 se). Cell E₂ mein se guzarte hue charge zyada se kam potential ki taraf jata hai, is liye energy E₂Q khota hai (−E₂Q). Resistor R₁ mein charge zyada se kam potential ki taraf jata hai aur energy IR₁Q khota hai (−IR₁Q); isi tarah R₂ mein −IR₂Q. Aakhir charge wapas E₁ ke negative terminal par pohanch jata hai jahan se chala tha. Energy ki conservation se kul tabdeeli zero hai:

blocks.alt: Mustateel loop: oopar ki taar mein resistance R1 aur cell E1, baen taraf cell E2, neeche resistance R2. Darmiyan khamdaar teer I: current anticlockwise.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.28: Kirchhoff ke second rule ke mutabiq E1 - IR1 - E2 - IR2 = 0 (kitab ki Figure 9.28 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: E₁ bara hai, is liye current anticlockwise hai. E₁ mein charge − se + jata hai (energy milti hai, +E₁); E₂ mein + se − (energy khota hai, −E₂); R₁ aur R₂ mein current ki direction mein −IR₁ aur −IR₂. Sab ka sum zero.
Yehi Kirchhoff ka doosra rule hai:

blocks.title: Kirchhoff ka doosra rule
blocks.text: Kisi band circuit mein potential ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic sum zero hota hai.
Yeh rule asal mein law of conservation of energy hai, bas electrical problems (bijli ke sawalon) ki zabaan mein.
Complex network par yeh rule lagane se pehle potential ki tabdeeli ke signs achhi tarah samajh lein:

items: Agar cell ko positive (+) se negative (−) terminal ki taraf paar karein to potential ki tabdeeli negative (−E) hai; ulti direction (− se +) mein positive (+E).
Agar resistor ko current ki direction mein paar karein to potential ki tabdeeli negative (−IR) hai; current ke khilaf positive (+IR).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke likhe hue rules (i) aur (ii) ulte signs dete hain: un ke mutabiq cell ko + se − aur resistor ko current ki direction mein paar karne par tabdeeli positive hai. Yeh ghalat hai: + se − jane par potential girta hai (−E), aur current ki direction mein resistor par bhi potential girta hai (−IR). Kitab ka apna "For your information" box, Example 9.10 aur procedure ka qadam (iv) yahi sahi signs istemal karte hain.

blocks.caption: Maloomat ke liye: E aur I ke signs
rows: Cell − se + ki taraf (kam se zyada potential)

blocks.alt: Do loops wala circuit, oopar nuqte e, b, a aur neeche f, c, d. Teeno khari shaakhon mein resistor ke oopar cell: baen E3 aur R3, darmiyan E2 aur R2, daen E1 aur R1. Clockwise teer loop currents I2 (baen loop) aur I1 (daen loop). Qeematein: R1 = 10 ohm, R2 = 30 ohm, R3 = 15 ohm; E1 = 40 V, E2 = 60 V, E3 = 50 V.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 9.29 mein "R₃ = 50V" chhapa hai; resistance volt mein nahi hoti aur R₃ = 15 Ω pehle hi diya gaya hai. Hal mein E₃ = 50 V istemal hota hai, is liye yahan E₃ = 50 V likha gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Beech wali shaakh (R₂, E₂) dono loops mein hai, is liye us mein current I₁ − I₂ hai. Dono loop currents ek hi direction (clockwise) mein assume kiye gaye hain.

blocks.title: Example 9.10
blocks.problem: Fig. 9.29 ke circuit ki teeno resistances mein current nikalein. R₁ = 10 Ω, R₂ = 30 Ω, R₃ = 15 Ω; E₁ = 40 V, E₂ = 60 V, E₃ = 50 V.
steps: Do loops chunein: abcda aur ebcfe; har resistance kam az kam ek loop mein aa jaye.
Pehle loop mein loop current I₁ aur doosre mein I₂ assume (farz) karein, dono clockwise (ek hi direction mein).
Loop abcda (a se clockwise): E₁ ko + se − paar karte hain: −E₁; R₁ mein −I₁R₁; R₂ mein is loop ka current I₁ positive aur I₂ negative, is liye −(I₁ − I₂)R₂; E₂ ko − se + paar karte hain: +E₂.
Loop ebcfe: −E₂ − (I₂ − I₁)R₂ − I₂R₃ + E₃ = 0 → −60 − 30(I₂ − I₁) − 15I₂ + 50 = 0
(i) se I₁ = (2 + 3I₂)/4; (ii) mein rakhein: 3 + 4.5I₂ − 9I₂ = 2, is liye I₂ = 2/9 A = 0.22 A aur I₁ = 2/3 A = 0.66 A
R₁ mein asal current = I₁ = 2/3 A = 0.66 A, a se d ki taraf.
R₂ mein asal current = I₁ − I₂ = 2/3 A − 2/9 A = 4/9 A = 0.44 A, bare current I₁ ki direction mein, c se b ki taraf.
blocks.answer: R₃ mein asal current = I₂ = 2/9 A = 0.22 A, f se e ki taraf.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Hal mein kitab likhti hai "Fig. 9.28 shows that I₁ and I₂ are the actual currents"; is example ka circuit Fig. 9.29 hai.
Circuit problems solve (hal) karne ka tareeqa
Is misal ke baad hum yehi tareeqa doosre complex D.C. networks par laga sakte hain. Kirchhoff ke rules istemal karte waqt yeh qadam uthayein:

items: Loops aise chunein ke har resistance kam az kam ek loop mein shamil ho.
Har loop mein ek loop current assume (farz) karein; saare loop currents ek hi direction mein hon, clockwise ya anticlockwise.
Har chune hue loop ki equation likhein: kisi hisse ko kam se zyada potential ki taraf paar karein to voltage ki tabdeeli positive, zyada se kam ki taraf negative.
In equations ko hal kar ke unknown (na-maloom) quantities nikalein.

blocks.prompt: "Poore circuit mein potential ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic sum zero hai": yeh kis ka statement hai (MCQ 9.9)? Kirchhoff ke rules state karein aur samjhayein (comprehensive question 9.2).
blocks.explanation: Yeh Kirchhoff ka doosra rule hai: option (d). Pehla rule: kisi junction par aane wale currents ka jor jane wale currents ke sum ke barabar hai (ΣI = 0), kyun ke charge conserved (mehfooz) rehta hai. Doosra rule: kisi bhi band loop mein emfs aur IR tabdeeliyon ka algebraic sum zero hai, kyun ke unit charge cells se jitni energy leta hai utni hi resistors mein kharch karta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Pehla rule (point rule, charge ki conservation): junction par ΣI = 0; I₁ + I₂ = I₃ + I₄ (9.44).
Doosra rule (loop rule, energy ki conservation): band loop mein potential tabdeeliyon ka algebraic sum = 0; E₁ − IR₁ − E₂ − IR₂ = 0 (9.45).
Signs: cell − se + par +E; current ke saath resistor −IR.
Example 9.10: R₁ mein 0.66 A, R₂ mein 0.44 A, R₃ mein 0.22 A. Tareeqa: diagram, loops, ek direction ke loop currents, equations, hal.
